title: ERROR:root:Synapse 1.61.0 needs Jinja2>=3.0, but can't determine Jinja2's version
body:
### Description

Matrix server has been running fine for about a year, a recent update seems to have somehow broke things..

It would not start and just tries to start over and over crashing in a loop:

Jun 18 20:21:31 Matrix systemd[1]: matrix-synapse.service: Control process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE
Jun 18 20:21:31 Matrix systemd[1]: matrix-synapse.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'.
Jun 18 20:21:31 Matrix systemd[1]: Failed to start Synapse Matrix homeserver.
Jun 18 20:21:31 Matrix systemd[1]: matrix-synapse.service: Consumed 1.355s CPU time.

I stopped the service and entered the virtual environment and tried to start it directly, and this is the error I see:

### `ERROR:root:Synapse 1.61.0 needs Jinja2>=3.0, but can't determine Jinja2's version`

I checked and Jinja2 seems to be fully installed and updated:

```
pip install --upgrade "Jinja2"
Requirement already up-to-date: Jinja2 in ./lib/python3.8/site-packages (3.1.2)
Requirement already satisfied, skipping upgrade: MarkupSafe>=2.0 in ./lib/python3.8/site-packages (from Jinja2) (2.1.1)
```

### Steps to reproduce
`/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/bin/python3.8 -m synapse.app.homeserver --config-path=/etc/matrix-synapse/homeserver.yaml --config-path=/etc/matrix-synapse/conf.d/ --generate-keys`

### Homeserver

self-hosted for 1 year.

### Synapse Version

no longer runs, but should be version 1.61.0

### Installation Method

~pip (from PyPI)~ Edit(@DMRobertson): this was incorrect, the reporter installed using the matrix.org debian packages.

### Platform

runs in Ubuntu 20.04 LXC container. (has without issue for about a year)

### Relevant log output

```shell
I understand its difficult without logs, the logs dont show anything useful, I am hoping that somebody else has ran into this and knows the cause.
```


### Anything else that would be useful to know?

Not that I can think of.
